note: Bugs seeded on purpose. Kept outside the sample folder so the scan cannot read it.

bugs.summary: eval() on teacher input runs arbitrary code, e.g. "__import__('os').system('...')".
No range check: -5 returns 'F' and 150 returns 'A' instead of being rejected.
total=0 raises ZeroDivisionError; obtained outside 0..total gives a percentage below 0 or above 100.
Empty list raises ZeroDivisionError (also reached through report_card with no subjects).
Uses > instead of >=, so a student with exactly the pass mark (40) is counted as failed.
Sorts ascending, so it returns the lowest scorers instead of the highest.
Mutable default argument: results from earlier calls leak into later calls.
